metric: mean |d| per channel (0-255) and % of pixels with |d| summed over RGB > 24, game capture vs each tool's render composited over the game's fighters-hidden plate with the same light model and registration; scored on the union of all tools' footprints (showcase_metric.py)

cases.title: UNI2 layered scene: CG + .pat part set 991 (additive flame, PRAS pivots, 3D ring arcs)
cases.notes: Additive point-sampled and PRFL-filtered .pat parts over the CG layer; the stage Bokashi pass and aura glow are modelled for every tool alike.
cases.caveat: Known residual for ours: the ring arcs (set 991 slots 41/44/45) change between game runs (render-match17); the per-layer bokashi split (--layers) is off here because only our editor can export per-layer shots.

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Close to the game (second best): the additive flame edges and ring arcs differ more than ours.
what_others_got_wrong.gonp: No .pat support: the whole set-991 flame/ring layer is missing; only the CG sprite is drawn.

cases.title: UNI2 rotated CG mid-tween (AFHK 1 interpolation, AFAZ rotation lerp, tick 27 of 55)
cases.notes: Needs AFHK interpolation between two keyframes plus a rotated, palette-indexed CG sprite.
cases.caveat: gonp has no animation playback, so it is shown at frame 0 (the keyframe tick 27 belongs to); its failure here is the sprite decode/palette, not only the missing tween.

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Wrong palette (light-blue body) and wrong pose: the mid-tween AFAZ rotation is not interpolated as the game does.
what_others_got_wrong.gonp: Sprite drawn as a solid green silhouette (UNI2 palette/format not decoded); no tween (no playback).

cases.title: UNI2 PUPS palette switch: CG 869 + .pat set 839 with PPPA-tinted parts
cases.pattern_frame: chr027 p449 f4 (zoom 1.5 editor vs zoom 1 game)
cases.notes: Palette bank chosen by the pattern's PUPS, plus per-part palette (PPPA) tint on the .pat layer.
cases.caveat: Close-up: v2_model drops view-wide rows/columns from every footprint (its grid-line guard), so only the lower-right of the sprite is scored, the same pixels for every tool.

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Wrong palette bank: the PUPS switch is not applied, so the coat comes out white/pink.
what_others_got_wrong.gonp: Wrong palette (orange coat); no PUPS/PPPA, no .pat layer.

cases.title: UNI2 .pat-only pattern with PRRV 3 (H+V flipped) streak parts
cases.notes: Pure .pat effect (no CG sprite on the frame): a tool without .pat support draws nothing.

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Draws the streaks but the PRRV 3 (H+V) flipped parts land off the game geometry.
what_others_got_wrong.gonp: No .pat support: draws nothing (the frame has no CG sprite).

cases.title: MBTL p238: translucent tray (.pat set 275, PRAL 1 + translucent parts) at real zoom 1.5

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Tray drawn, but the translucent purple glow parts are missing.

cases.title: MBTL p157: additive arcs (PRRV 2) + the puddle effect at real zoom 1.5
cases.caveat: The puddle (p158 spawn) is in the game frame; scored pixels are the union of the tools' footprints, so game-only pixels outside every tool's footprint are not scored.

what_others_got_wrong.sosfiro: Arcs tinted red/magenta instead of white/cyan, and no puddle (no spawned-pattern preview).

cases.title: MBTL CG sprite at zoom 1.5 with the game's CG zoom filter (Filter_V) and BgColor light
cases.notes: Plain idle sprite: every tool loads it; the difference is the zoom filter. The training frame counter box is excluded.
cases.caveat: Control-style case (one CG sprite) to show the zoom filter, not a complex scene. sosfiro and gonp give identical numbers: neither applies the game's CG zoom filter (Filter_V) at 1.5x.

what_others_got_wrong.gonp: No CG zoom filter (Filter_V) at 1.5x (same numbers as sosfiro).

cases.title: ActCadenza moon-3 Akiha p238 frame 4 with effect.ha6 spawns (MBAACC data)
cases.notes: Editor-only, qualitative: ours previews the spawned effect patterns (red flame); gonp shows the character sprite correctly but no effects; sosfiro capture build crashed.
cases.caveat: No game column and no metric: gamecap drives UNI2 and MBTL only. The sosfiro capture build exits with code 5 (minidump) loading MBAACC akiha_0 or akiha_3 (.txt and .HA6); this was not reproduced in sosfiro's own UI, so it is NOT counted as a sosfiro failure. Manual check: sosfiro File > Load from .txt > akiha_3.txt, pattern 238, frame 4.

what_others_got_wrong.gonp: no effect-spawn preview; the sprite itself is right
